PT/FM EMULATOR
PT/FM's own firmware, compiled for the browser: the FM-1 on this page

POWER

OFF: A CLICK ON THE PAGE SWITCHES IT ON

RESET: off and on again, its flash kept. ERASE DATA: the flash and the page's settings gone from this browser, a new FM-1 (tap it twice).

DISKS

A disk into the emulated FM-1, as the install page seeds the real one: its plan first, then WRITE. The flash is kept in this browser.

ITS USB MIDI

The browser asks for MIDI when a list is first opened.

THE FM-1 OVER MIDI

MIDI: OFF

The real FM-1 as this one's controls: SETTINGS → MIDI → MIDI CONTROLLER, mirror mode (REC at its start). Its LEDs follow the page.

FIT: as big as the window holds

FIRMWARE

looking for it

HOW TO PLAY

  • BUTTONS, KEYS: click or touch; several fingers hold several; SHIFT+click holds one
  • SLIDE ALONG THE KEYS: each key the finger reaches plays (buttons stay held)
  • KNOBS: − / + (held: repeats, faster), drag, the wheel
  • MASTER: drag the bar; a double-click: half
  • KEYBOARD: Z … / F3-A4 (S D F H J L ; ' the black), Q … Y B4-G5 (3 4 6)
  • HOME + LFO: the help for the screen shown
  • RIGHT-CLICK THE SCREEN: save or copy it
